_read_me: Copy this file to legal/owner.json (git-ignored: it never goes to GitHub) and fill in the 'you' part. Then run: npm run legal. Everything else is already filled in for the recommended setup. docs/Go_live.md, step 5, explains every field.

you.homeAddress: only needed if publishHomeAddress is true: number, street, postcode, city, country
you.phone: only needed if publishHomeAddress is true: +33 6 12 34 56 78
